TL;DR


5


Quick Takeaways


Five findings marketers can use when measuring TV campaigns.


1. 1


A TV ad was the only touchpoint in the campaign before 54% of site visits.


2. 2


Seventy-eight percent of conversions came after the viewer had seen a TV ad.


3. 3


Most site visits arrived quickly: 43% within a day and 82% within a week.


4. 4


Conversions took longer, with about half arriving after the first week.


5. 5


A seven-day report would miss about half of conversions, so wait for the full 25-day window before judging results.
